A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FedAda2/FedAda2++ work. Their readable text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices support reliable comparison despite extensive reformatting and relocation.

before.justification: v2 reports original image and text experiments, learning curves, and configuration analyses in Section 5 and Appendices H–J.

after.justification: v3 retains original benchmark experiments and analyses of hyperparameters, local computation, optimizer configurations, and delayed updates.

M1.justification: Zero initialization, independent server/client adaptivity, SM3 compression, delayed updates, and blended optimization remain unchanged. Algorithm renumbering and removal of the standard Adam pseudocode do not change the proposed procedures.

E1.justification: The reported experiments retain StackOverflow, CIFAR-100, GLD-23K, and FEMNIST, including privacy constraints and varying client resources. Relocating their results introduces no new dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: v3 Table 1 adds an explicit FedAdam row to the resource-cost comparison. MIME/MIMELite already appeared in v2 Table 3 and are relocated; the empirical comparator sets remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The retained experiments preserve model configurations, participation rates, hyperparameter grids, local-epoch budgets, and evaluation procedures. The DP setting remains noise multiplier 1 with privacy budget (13.1, 0.0025). Expanded cost-accounting explanations do not establish a protocol change.

E4.justification: Local-epoch, hyperparameter, heterogeneous-optimizer, full-finetuning, and delayed-update analyses are retained. In particular, v2 Figure 3 is split across v3 Figures 4 and 9, while v2 Figures 8–9 become v3 Figures 10–11.

E5.justification: Both versions report 20 repetitions with different random seeds and shaded 95% confidence intervals. The new checklist restates this practice without changing the uncertainty methodology.

E6.justification: Retained performance plots match. v3 omits the five-local-epoch DP StackOverflow loss curves and accuracy–loss mismatch observation from v2 Figure 1. Its resource table also adds FedAdam's explicit cost entry.

T1.justification: Assumption 2 changes from bounded stochastic gradients to bounded full gradients. v3 removes the Cauchy-noise construction and Appendix B.2 proofs supporting the general regret claims, although those claims remain as Theorem A.5 and Proposition A.6. The Student-t construction is retained and relocated to A.1.

C1.justification: v3 removes the introduction's blanket claim that no convergence results exist for jointly adaptive federated optimization in general convex or non-convex settings. Appendix B states a more specific novelty claim about analytically characterized guarantees. Core algorithm and efficiency claims remain.

C2.justification: v3 adds stale preconditioners as motivation for zero initialization and discusses how larger update delays can slow theoretical convergence. It removes the interpretation that the learning-rate bounds demonstrate resilience to suboptimal server learning rates. The SM3 denoising hypothesis is retained.

D1.justification: v3 adds dataset-source links and checklist statements about releasing code, without providing a code-access link. Appendix I.3 removes the approximately six GPU-years total-compute estimate while retaining hardware descriptions and experimental hyperparameters.

R1.justification: v3 adds discussions or citations concerning FedDA, FedSPS, FedNAR, and privacy-related work. New Appendix B expands the comparison with Wang et al., emphasizing communication overhead and analytically characterized convergence bounds.

P1.justification: v3 substantially reorganizes the reading flow: vision and efficiency results precede privacy results, the heavy-tail construction moves before the general regret discussion, and a new related-work appendix and NeurIPS checklist are inserted. It also adds explanatory introductions to the main appendix proofs.

P2.justification: The document adopts NeurIPS typography and page layout. Main Figures 1–2 lose their StackOverflow columns, DP accuracy becomes Figure 3, and the hyperparameter-sweep display moves to Appendix J. Cost tables are consolidated, and numerous figures and algorithms are repositioned.

improvement.justification: Clearer explanations and sharper positioning help readability, but retained Theorem A.5 and Proposition A.6 lose their detailed proofs from v2 Appendix B.2. v3 also retains a reference to the omitted Cauchy construction. These omissions weaken verifiability, alongside reduced loss and compute disclosure. The core method, convergence analysis, and most experimental evidence remain intact, limiting the overall decline.
